subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start policy should OpenClaw expose for bare `/new` and `/reset` across static acknowledgements, startup/model turns, prompt text, greeting suppression, and optional cheaper greeting-model routing?
rationale: The remaining work adds compatibility-sensitive config and changes session-start plus model-routing semantics, so automation should not invent the key shape or default behavior.

options.title: Add One Typed Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Keep current behavior until maintainers choose the contract, then add a single policy that covers startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing.

options.title: Restore Startup Turns By Default
options.body: Make bare resets run the startup/model turn again and intentionally own the token-cost, latency, and upgrade behavior change.

options.title: Keep Acknowledgement-Only Defaults
options.body: Leave current bare reset acknowledgements as the product default and document `/new <message>` or narrower prompt/fallthrough trackers as the supported paths.

recommendation.title: Add One Typed Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Keep current behavior until maintainers choose the contract, then add a single policy that covers startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current acknowledgement contract, gateway fast reset behavior, and prior reset-policy review.
